The '''city on the hills''' was a city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teardrop]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had a base there, but it was evacuated only moments before [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']] arrived to [[Teardrop massacre|punish]] the Rebels. The entire population of the city was killed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
